comparison.objective: Open an anti-static bag, remove one cell, and seat it upright while leaving the other cell undisturbed; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Battery task tests slider pulling, selective extraction, orientation-aware placement, and sequencing around a deformable-like articulated bag; candidate tests hex-key insertion, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, torque-limited relocking, and proof cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Battery task requires ≥90% slider travel, one cell seated within 3 mm and 10°, the other retained, arm return, and no fallen cell; candidate evaluates dynamic stopping behavior and drift.
comparison.reason: Selective unpacking and cell placement do not test mechanism commissioning. Missing rubric details: bag opening is implemented by switched hinge targets rather than a contact-only zipper.
